home.headline: Understand your land records. Know your next step.
home.intro: Practical guidance on Jamabandi, Khata-Khesra, mutation paperwork and land-document discrepancies.
home.heroNote: From a retired Senior UDC of the Bihar government, now working as an independent consultant in Gaya.
home.servicesIntro: Clear, fixed starting fees. You know the cost before any work begins.

why.title: Experience with revenue records
why.text: Guidance from someone who has worked in revenue administration in Bihar and understands how land records are kept.

why.title: In Hindi or English
why.text: Explanations in the language you are comfortable with, for families in Bihar and those living elsewhere.

why.title: Fees stated upfront
why.text: Each service has a stated fee and scope. Government charges and other professionals’ fees are always separate.

why.title: Honest about limits
why.text: If your matter needs an advocate, a surveyor or the circle office, we tell you plainly instead of promising results.

home.bioText: Bameshwaar Singh is a retired Senior UDC from the Bihar government with experience in revenue administration and land records. He now helps landowners understand their papers and plan the right next step.

process.title: Send your question
process.text: Use the enquiry form with a short description of your land-record problem.

process.title: We call you back
process.text: We contact you on the number you give to understand the matter and confirm the service and fee.

process.title: Review and guidance
process.text: We go through the records you share and explain what they show and what is missing.

process.title: Your next step
process.text: You get clear direction on the next official or professional step to take.

home.contactTitle: Have a question about your land papers?
home.contactText: Send an enquiry in Hindi or English. Based in Gaya, Bihar; guidance available for land anywhere in Bihar.

services.title: Services and fees
services.intro: Each service below has a defined scope, a clear deliverable and a stated fee. If you are unsure which one fits, start with an initial consultation.
feesNote: These are proposed starting fees and may be revised. The fee is confirmed with you before any work begins.
Fees do not include government fees, application or stamp charges, surveyor (amin) fees, advocate fees or travel costs.
We do not guarantee any official decision or outcome.

consultation.name: Initial consultation (up to 20 minutes)
consultation.scope: A phone or in-person discussion of your land-record question.
consultation.deliverable: An explanation of your situation and a suggested next step.
consultation.limits: No detailed document review or written report.

jamabandi.name: Jamabandi and land-record review
jamabandi.scope: Review of your Jamabandi and the related records you provide, such as khatiyan, deed and rent receipts.
jamabandi.deliverable: An explanation of what the records show and any mismatches found.
jamabandi.limits: Based only on the documents you share; not a title verification.

mutation.name: Mutation paperwork guidance
mutation.scope: Help to understand the mutation (dakhil-kharij) process and organise your documents for the application.
mutation.deliverable: A document checklist for your case and guidance on the application steps.
mutation.limits: You or your authorised representative submit the application. We cannot influence the decision.

discrepancy.name: Document discrepancy report
discrepancy.scope: A detailed comparison of names, numbers and areas across your land documents.
discrepancy.deliverable: A written report listing each discrepancy and the likely route to correct it.
discrepancy.limits: Not a legal opinion. Disputes over ownership need an advocate.

survey.name: Land-survey document preparation
survey.scope: Help to organise documents needed for survey-related work.
survey.deliverable: Depends on your case; agreed in writing before work starts.
survey.limits: Does not include measurement or surveyor (amin) work.

contact.title: Request a consultation
contact.intro: Tell us briefly about your land-record question. We will call you back to understand it and confirm the service and fee.
instructions: Keep the mauza, thana number, khata, khesra and Jamabandi number handy if you know them.
Describe the problem in a few sentences. Do not send documents through this form.
Do not share Aadhaar numbers, bank details or passwords.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you send an enquiry we store: your name, mobile number, preferred language, the service you chose, the district (if you choose one) and your message.

To prevent misuse of the form, the server keeps a short-lived record linked to your internet (IP) address for rate limiting, for up to one day. Our hosting providers may keep their own technical logs under their policies.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
paragraphs: Only to respond to your enquiry: to call you back, understand your question and offer a service. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Who can see it
paragraphs: The consultant, Bameshwaar Singh, through a password-protected administration page.
Your enquiry is stored with the companies that host this website and its database. They process it on our behalf to run the service.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Open enquiries are kept until they are dealt with. Closed enquiries are reviewed and deleted after about 12 months, unless we need them for an ongoing consultation.

sections.heading: Correction and deletion
paragraphs: You can ask us to correct or delete your enquiry by contacting us using the details on the contact page. We will confirm once it is done.

sections.heading: What not to send
paragraphs: Please do not send Aadhaar numbers, bank details, passwords or copies of documents through the enquiry form.

sections.heading: Language preference
paragraphs: Your browser stores your language choice (Hindi or English) so the site opens in that language next time. This website does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
points: Bihar Bhoomi Sahayata is an independent, private consultancy. It is not a government office, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Bihar or any of its departments.
We provide guidance on understanding land records and organising documents. This is not legal advice. For disputes or court matters, consult a qualified advocate.
We do not guarantee any official decision, timeline or outcome.
Our fees do not include government fees, stamp or application charges, surveyor fees or advocate fees.
Articles on this website are general information and may become out of date as rules and portals change. Always confirm the current procedure from official sources.
